InterpolationMethod.reason: The yield curve config stores the method as text and ORE applies this parser to the accessor in OREData/ored/marketdata/yieldcurve.cpp, so the parser is the one ORE reads this leaf with, though it is not applied in the config parser.

InterpolationVariable.reason: Stored as text by the yield curve config and parsed by this function beside the interpolation method, in the same header.

ExtrapolationMethod.reason: Stored as text by the yield curve config; ORE parses the accessor, so this is the parser for the leaf.

TimeInterpolation.reason: The FX volatility config reads TimeInterpolation as one of the time-interpolation codes, and this is the parser that accepts them.

Compounding.reason: The convolution and default curve configs read a compounding rule, which this parser accepts.

Frequency.reason: A frequency the ORE parsers accept, used by the default curve and security configs.
